text: そろそろ　たたかわせて　みよう　こんどは　いける　だろう！

structure.jp: そろそろ　たたかわせて　みよう
structure.en: it's about time I tried letting them battle

structure.jp: こんどは　いける　だろう！
structure.en: this time it should go well!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making or letting someone else fight. たたかわせて = 'letting them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかわせて　みよう
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus みる means trying something to see how it goes, and みよう is the 'let's' form of it. たたかわせて みよう = 'let's try letting them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end says the speaker expects something to be true without being fully sure. いける だろう = 'it should go well'.
